verdict.rationale: Basecamp's documented assignment views and Everything Views only pull together items across Basecamp's own projects. Nothing in the evidence shows it importing or aggregating assigned tasks from other project management tools such as Jira or Asana. The REST API and MCP support are developer building blocks rather than a built-in cross-tool unified view, and calendar subscription pushes data out rather than pulling tasks in.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view
